text:
mei (People Ops): quick ask 1 can we run a 'Lunchbox Spotlight' week next month with micro spot-awards tied to culture values? idea: small $25 award + handwritten note handed during lunch. :bento:
dan (People Ops): love that. is this more ops-heavy than the usual sticker table?
rachel (HRBP): fine by me but need an opt-in for notes (some folks prefer none). also confirm budget and approval flow.
mei (People Ops): plan: 5 winners across the week, each $25. nominations via a 1-line form. submissions close Fri prior.
samir (Eng): can we limit to peer nominations only? makes it feel grassroots.
rachel (HRBP): peer noms ok. form fields: `nominee`, `nominator`, `one-line reason`, `manager ok?` (checkbox).
dan (People Ops): budget check: 5x25 = 125 + handwritten cards & lunch supplies ~35 = 160. we have $350 monthly culture budget so we're good.
mei (People Ops): logistics: pick 5 lunch days, set a table near kitchen, small printed card + envelope with gift card inside. volunteers to hand out?
samir (Eng): i can volunteer Wed and Thu lunch.
dan (People Ops): i'll coordinate print & envelopes. samir, can you grab the prepaid cards from finance or should i?
rachel (HRBP): finance prefers a single PO. i'll route the $160 request and add code `CULTURE-2026`.
mei (People Ops): poster copy draft: "Lunchbox Spotlight: nominate a teammate for a small token of appreciation. Winners announced Mon-Fri. Nominate here: <https://forms.gle/fake-link>" ok?
dan (People Ops): maybe add "opt-out of notes" link.
mei (People Ops): good call, adding: "To opt out of handwritten notes, contact peopleops@redwoodinference.com."
kudos-bot: reminder set 1 scheduled to post in #general at 2026-04-05 09:00.
mei (People Ops): final question: do we include remote folks? i'd like a digital alternative (e-card + $25 e-gift).
rachel (HRBP): include remote. make an e-card workflow and mark shipping addresses if physical is chosen.
dan (People Ops): ok i'll add an "in-office / remote" selector on the form and a shipping field.
mei (People Ops): perfect. i'll draft the poster and form today and drop in #people-ops-assets. thanks team :raised_hands:
